object_mapping.input: Explicit finite integer complexes/reactions,fixedpositive rates,x0 and proposedEulersteps
object_mapping.continuous: xdot=sum k*x^y*(yprime-y) in fixed stoichiometric class
object_mapping.discrete: xnext=x+h*f(x);this map needs an independent positivity/regioncertificate

additional_assumptions: Weakly reversible finite graph,nonnegative integer complexes,fixed positive rates
Do not infer stochastic permanence,uncertain time-varyingrates,explicit epsilonP oruniformT overx0
Preserve mass/stoichiometry checks and solver arithmetic tolerance separately
hypothesis: 在预先固定的弱可逆质量作用合成例中，存在连续模型符合源文前提但显式Euler产生负坐标的步长；分开两类证书可标出全部此类错误保证，并对满足逐步非负条件的对照不误标为已证长期数值永久性。
baseline: Incorrect rule:weakreversibility plus continuous permanence implies every Eulerstep positive. Honest older baseline:direct coordinate update check and per-step h bound;one-linkage examples already covered historically.
incremental_value: Workflow claim hygiene,not a new integrator. General fixed-rate permanence widens continuous structural applicability;the proposed stepcheck itself has no claimed2026benefit.

test_plan.fixtures: Freeze small reversible networks,positive rationalrates/initials andexplicitrationalsteps including stable/oversizedcontrols;do not selectstepsafterresults. Include exact closed-formcontrol whereavailable.
test_plan.oracle: Exact rationalEulerupdates plus independent matrix-exponential/analytic continuoussolution on linear reversible controls. Nonlinear ormultilinkagenetworks requireseparate validatedODEevidence.
test_plan.success: At least one valid continuousmodel with negativeEulercoordinate;guard catches all knownfalseclaims andneverpromotesfinitehorizons to eventualpermanence.

limits: 计划尚未运行；没有实际生化数据、非线性区间解算器、有效K_P构造或永久性数值证书。线性/单链接控制仅检验误用，不能展示新多链接定理增益。
resource_envelope: Proposed rational arithmetic fixture audit <=60seconds/64MiB;no heavyODEdependencies;not run.
